title: When can a Safe Deposit Boxes charge be credited: bank error and courtesy waiver credits
content:
## Scope

This policy governs credits that reduce what a lessee owes on a Safe Deposit Boxes rental: how a credit relates to the charge it offsets, the bank error credit, the courtesy waiver credit for a late fee, and the rule against crediting the same charge twice for the same reason.

## Policy clause

1. **One charge, capped.** Every credit is tied to the one charge it offsets, and never exceeds that charge.
2. **Bank error credit.** A bank error credit reverses a charge made contrary to the Safe Deposit Boxes policy, such as rent charged at the wrong branch adjustment, rent charged without the discount the lessee qualified for, or a late fee charged on rent that was paid within the grace days. Bank error credits have no limit.
3. **Courtesy waiver credit.** A courtesy waiver credit applies only to a late fee, and only while the customer's count of courtesy waivers is below the courtesy allowance for the box size of the rental. The count is the number of courtesy waiver credits on any of the customer's rentals within the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the current date.
4. **Once per reason.** A charge can be credited at most once for the same reason. This is judged from the credits already recorded against that same charge.
5. **Other credits.** Credits for unused rent, the key deposit and a size change follow the rules for surrender and size change.

## Courtesy allowance by box size

| Official box size | Courtesy late fee waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days |
|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 2 |

## Credit reasons at a glance

| Credit reason | What it may offset | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Bank error | A charge made contrary to the Safe Deposit Boxes policy | No limit |
| Courtesy waiver | A late fee only | Only while the customer's courtesy count is below the allowance |
| Unused rent, key deposit, size change | As set by the surrender and size change rules | As set by those rules |

## Courtesy waiver: condition table

| Charge to be credited | Courtesy waivers in the last 365 days, all the customer's rentals | Rental's box size | Courtesy waiver conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Late fee | 0 | 3x5 (allowance 1) | Met |
| Late fee | 1 | 3x5 (allowance 1) | Not met |
| Late fee | 1 | 10x15 (allowance 2) | Met |
| Late fee | 2 | 10x20 (allowance 2) | Not met |
| Rent charge or service fee | Any | Any | Not met: courtesy waivers apply only to late fees |

A late fee that has already received a courtesy waiver credit cannot receive a second courtesy waiver credit.

## Basis Q&A

**The late fee was charged on rent paid within the grace days. Is that a courtesy waiver?** No. A late fee charged on rent paid within the grace days is a charge contrary to policy and is credited as a bank error, which has no limit and does not use the courtesy allowance.

**Can a credit be larger than the charge it reverses?** No. A credit never exceeds the charge it offsets.

**Do courtesy waivers on the customer's other boxes count?** Yes. The count covers courtesy waiver credits on any of the customer's rentals within the rolling 365 calendar days.
